_comment: Project-scoped Prime Agent settings for the CYPRESS seed. Commit to git so the team shares the same resource surface. Prime Agent auto-discovers .prime/agent/{skills,prompts,extensions}/ by convention; these arrays list them explicitly (bare names, which resolve relative to .prime/agent/) so the seed's resources still load if a project runs under a locked-down or non-default config. Recursion depth (RLM_MAX_DEPTH) is set globally, per session, or by env, not here: integrations/prime-agent/README.md says how to raise it to reach the seed's deepest delegation chain.
